name: Elias Mercer
want: bring every wagon to Oregon before the snow, and lose no one on the way
secret: He sold his Ohio farm to pay a debt he hid from his late wife, and has almost nothing left but his wagon and the company's trust.
voice: Short sentences, a sergeant's habit of giving orders as suggestions.
description: A Union quartermaster sergeant in the war who organised the company's outfitting at Council Bluffs so well that they elected him captain. Widowed last winter.
appearance: Tall and spare, grey-bearded at forty-four, an army slouch hat and a limp he never mentions.
